svg.title: A vine bracelet on the back of the hand and forearm, on deep skin, in five steps. 1: thin light lead lines: a curve around the wrist, a line up to a circle on the back of the hand, and a vine that spirals down the forearm, leaving one edge and coming back on the other. 2: lime green vine stems over the lines. 3: green leaves along the vines, on alternate sides. 4: a pink five-petal flower on the back of the hand and a small one on the wrist, with thin black outlines. Done: light veins in the leaves, white highlights on the petals, and white dot trails along the bracelet and the vines.
